note: Live-session recording (series/tools/rec). The bash lines of demo.md are run as PowerShell on the laptop; PYTHONPATH and the endpoint are set in prepare, never echoed.
prepare: # owner signs in as labadmin (device code), not on camera
az account show --query name -o none 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { az login --use-device-code }
$me = az ad signed-in-user show --query id -o tsv
az group create -n rg-mglab-ai-01 -l swedencentral -o none
az cognitiveservices account create -g rg-mglab-ai-01 -n $n -l swedencentral --kind OpenAI --sku S0 --custom-domain $n --yes -o none; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw 'Azure OpenAI account create failed' }
$id = az cognitiveservices account show -g rg-mglab-ai-01 -n $n --query id -o tsv

az cognitiveservices account deployment create -g rg-mglab-ai-01 -n $n --deployment-name triage-mini --model-name gpt-5-mini --model-version 2025-08-07 --model-format OpenAI --sku-name DataZoneStandard --sku-capacity 10 -o none; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw 'model deployment create failed' }

az role assignment create --assignee-object-id $me --assignee-principal-type User --role 'Cognitive Services OpenAI User' --scope $id -o none; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw 'role assignment create failed' }
Start-Sleep -Seconds 300   # role assignment propagation (up to 5 minutes)
python -m triage.evaluate --data data/tickets.jsonl --prompt v2 --dry-run | Select-Object -First 20 | Out-Null

screens.name: deployment
steps: Sign-in is already done as labadmin; pick the lab resource in rg-mglab-ai-01
Pause on model name gpt-5-mini, version 2025-08-07, deployment type and the rate limit (TPM)
mask: signed-in user UPN/avatar in the portal header

screens.name: scorecard
commands: python -m triage.evaluate --data data/tickets.jsonl --prompt v1 --prompt v2 --deployment triage-mini --model gpt-5-mini

screens.name: attack
commands: python -m triage.evaluate --data data/tickets.jsonl --prompt v1 --prompt v2 --deployment triage-mini --model gpt-5-mini --show | Select-String A02

screens.name: temperature
commands:
@'
import os
from triage.evaluate import make_client
client = make_client(os.environ["AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT"], max_retries=0)
try:
    r = client.chat.completions.create(model="triage-mini", temperature=0,
                                       messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Say OK"}])
    print("accepted:", r.choices[0].message.content)
except Exception as e:
    print(type(e).__name__, getattr(e, "status_code", ""), e)
'@ | python -
mask: the error text may contain the resource endpoint host: blur it if it does

teardown: az cognitiveservices account purge -g rg-mglab-ai-01 -n $env:AOAI_NAME -l swedencentral
